canonical_example.translation: She defied her father and attended a college far away from home.

canonical_example.text: Debes tomar una dosis de ibuprofeno cada ocho horas por cuatro días.
canonical_example.translation: You need to take a dose of ibuprofen every eight hours for four days.

canonical_example.text: Para dejar de tomar este medicamento hay que reducir la dosis a la mitad cada semana.
canonical_example.translation: To stop taking this medication, you need to cut the dosage in half each week.

canonical_example.text: Trabajar con ella va a requerir una buena dosis de paciencia.
canonical_example.translation: Working with her is going to require a great deal of patience.

canonical_example.text: Mi cuñada es una mujer difícil. Solo me la trago en pequeñas dosis.
canonical_example.translation: My sister-in-law is a difficult woman. I can only take her in small doses.

canonical_example.text: Ella continúa la tarea a pesar de estar muy cansada.
canonical_example.translation: She continues the task even though she's very tired.

canonical_example.text: Este comportamiento no puede continuar.
canonical_example.translation: This behavior can't continue.

canonical_example.text: ¿Vas a continuar a trabajar con ese cliente?

canonical_example.text: Tienes que continuar el proyecto a pesar de los obstáculos.
canonical_example.translation: You have to carry on with the project despite the obstacles.

canonical_example.text: El sendero para bicicletas continúa por toda la ciudad.
canonical_example.translation: The bicycle path continues throughout the city.

canonical_example.text: ¡El español es mi idioma favorito!

canonical_example.translation: Drop that cookie! I saw it first!

canonical_example.translation: The teacher put down the chalk and picked up the eraser.

canonical_example.translation: First release the brake, then put your foot on the gas pedal.

canonical_example.translation: You can either cough up the money, or we'll find another way to make you pay.

canonical_example.text: La calcomanía se soltó cuando se mojó.
canonical_example.translation: The sticker came off when it got wet.

canonical_example.text: El director de doblaje pidió una grabación con las voces de los candidatos.
canonical_example.translation: The dubbing director asked for a recording of the candidates' voices.
